title: Photos of his New Orleans band with Jeff Riddick
summary: Looking at a photograph, Fougerat names the band he had in New Orleans: Jeff Riddick, Billy Newburger, Al Bernard, Frank Topey, Marshall Farrell.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, well, the band is in the back, you see. So, I went into something different for a while. I was, uh... Playing mostly stage work. And, uh... Well, I did that for a long time, too. I was batted on the road, and we hit, uh... One-nighters, and... Played all over the country. But this show, this was not a show here, the Hollywood Scandals. This was a band I had down here in New Orleans. I met Jeff Riddick, and... I don't know. A couple of boys. I don't know if you know them all.
I don't know. I see Jeff right there.
But others, I don't believe I know. Uh... Billy Newburger. You don't know. He's a drummer? Yeah, he's a drummer. This is Al Bernard. This is Frank Topey.
He plays Frank Topey? Topey, yeah. He plays saxophone.
He's a saxophone, Marshall Farrell. That was Jeff back here, and Al Bernard.
He's the same guy that's back in town, not a bass player, huh?
